title: The Grateful Dead Live at Niagara Falls Convention Center on 1984-04-17
source: Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLI C-90) Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 24-bit/96KHz) > Soundforge 9.0 (edits) > flac24

ai_review.summary: Excellent recording with superb acoustics and a standout performance by Brent on keys
ai_review.review: The fan review praises the audio as crystal‑clear and the overall acoustic balance as excellent. Brent’s keyboard work is highlighted as particularly brilliant, making this capture a must‑listen despite the lack of detailed setlist information.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 5‑star review; it emphasizes superb recording quality and Brent's playing, but provides no detail on the musical set, so rating leans high but confidence is limited.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes excellent recording and acoustics; sound is clear, well‑balanced and captures the band’s dynamics nicely.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent is described as génial (great) by the reviewer
